pairs.subject: agent-instruction-files
pairs.evidence: CLAUDE.md:199 The always-loaded file's definition of done lists the gate's stages without docs:sync:test and docs:sync, even though package.json:18 has chained both into `check` since 0fa607f (2026-08-24), so an agent trusts a gate description that leaves out this context's own blocking checker.

techniques.evidence: CLAUDE.md:137 Undated stage inventory, copied by hand, that drifted when docs:sync joined `check` on 2026-08-24. The context's own verify-loop.mjs:16 derives the same list from package.json instead of copying it, and that is the safe form. Also, scripts/sentinel/path-oracle.ts:5 cites 'CLAUDE.md:190-193' as the brand rule, but those lines now hold the CI node-24 pin; the rule sits at CLAUDE.md:95/201.

CLAUDE.md:220 The demotion is real: check-doc-sync.mjs is a blocking commit-msg rung, and self-test.mjs proves it fires (check-doc-sync.mjs:117). But the instruction file still states the rule as prose and never names the gate, its `Doc-sync:` dismissal trailer, or `npm run docs:sync`. An agent that gets blocked has nothing to cooperate with.

package.json:26 Completeness direction: sentinel, path-oracle, smoke and docs:sync exist as runnable capabilities, but a grep of CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md finds none of them named. Only the kpi:* meters are named there (CLAUDE.md:109-110).
